_comment: PUBLIC DATA ONLY. Geographic classification inputs for the Capital Markets Preview sandbox. Contains no Woodmont, competitor, ownership, recipient, pricing or operational information. Boundaries here are either stakeholder-stated rules or public county names verified against the U.S. Census county list; nothing in this file is inferred.
_sources: Stakeholder-supplied classification (2026-09-18): the NJ Turnpike Exit 6 rule and latitude, and the PA, FL and NY county tiers recorded below.

U.S. Census Bureau 2020 Place-to-County relationship files and 2026 Gazetteer — used only to VERIFY that every county name below exists and is spelled canonically, not to choose which counties belong to a tier.

_tiers.UNMAPPED: Recognized as in-state but NOT assigned a tier. Held, never silently treated as national or as target. Applies to FL counties outside the target and broader lists; NJ has no UNMAPPED municipalities.

NJ.notes: A NJ municipality whose representative latitude is STRICTLY GREATER THAN exit6Latitude is TARGET; a municipality at or below the line is BROADER. No NJ municipality is left UNMAPPED. Municipalities with a null latitude in capital-markets-places.json fall back to BROADER. The latitude is a straight-line proxy for the Exit 6 boundary, so municipalities straddling the line may need manual correction - use overrides. As of 2026-09-21 no NJ municipality sits exactly on the line; the nearest below is Florence (40.0951) and the nearest above is Brielle (40.1051).
NJ._overridesNote: Manual per-municipality corrections near the boundary. Key is "Municipality|County" exactly as it appears in capital-markets-places.json; value is "TARGET" or "BROADER". An override always wins over the latitude rule and over the null-latitude fallback. Empty until a specific municipality is corrected. Example: "Florence|Burlington": "TARGET".

FL._derivation: BUSINESS-MARKET INTERPRETATION, not an FDOT-defined commercial market. This broader set encodes the stated business rule "anything including/south of Pasco, Polk, Lake, Seminole, Brevard" as an explicit county list, derived from public county geography. FDOT does not publish this list and does not define these counties as a market, so it must not be cited as an FDOT standard. Miami-Dade, Broward and Palm Beach are deliberately EXCLUDED from this list because they are already TARGET. Florida counties in neither list remain UNMAPPED.

_regionsNote: A region is a named area that is neither a county nor a municipality. It resolves only when the stakeholder explicitly stated its tier, and it is listed here so the mapping is visible rather than buried in code. Region matching is case-insensitive on the whole phrase.
